results.name: CSMDoorBookNook
results.description:
a book nook based off of the door in chainsaw man.
the caseing is made with 3mm thick wood and is about 116mm x 209mm x 191mm so it should be able to fit most book shelfs.
theres some space on the roof to fit a small battery pack and a led.
added the blend file you can see the way i placed the wood incase you wanna take a closer look or if you wanna make some edits
let me know if theres anything wrong with the model that i could fix

the grates were made from some spare window mesh
3d printed most of it in resin on the mars 2 pro however frame 1-4, vent, and 3d floor were printed in a fdm printer.
also the roof pipe file would probably need to be sliced if your printer is to small

you can see the irl print on my twitter [here](https://x.com/tacobocchi/status/1944552443053781101)![](https://pbs.twimg.com/media/GvxwIauWQAAQV5V?format=jpg&name=large)

results.name: Abandoned Sci-Fi Lab Glitching Tech& Alien Vines
results.description: This model features an **abandoned sci-fi lab with broken experiment chambers, flickering neon lights, and rusted robotic arms. Holographic monitors display glitching data, while shattered glass and debris cover the metallic floor**. A glowing energy core sits at the center, surrounded by damaged control panels. Alien vines creep through  walls, giving the lab a cyberpunk horror feel with worn PBR textures, metallic grates, and atmospheric neon lighting for a realistic, eerie vibe.

results.name: I Con Arena
results.description:
I-CON Arena
Three vertical layers. One objective. No safe corners.
A close-quarters tactical arena built for aggressive multiplayer gameplay — main floor, dual-tier catwalks, and an underground tunnel network all feeding into the same contested space. Ten ladders, nine tunnel grates, and 24 catwalk supports keep movement constant and rotations punishing.
The central tower owns the map. Take it or play around it — either way it dictates the fight. Corner bunkers, 28 crates, L-shaped clusters, and striped barriers reward smart cover use, while alcoves on every wall keep flanks alive.
Emissive blue, red, green, and orange lighting zones the map naturally. Fog keeps it atmospheric.
633 named mesh objects, 20 PBR materials, clean glTF 2.0 binary. Engine-ready, no external dependencies.
